segments.text: Ok so this is the Pausing the Agent for Input page for Google Antigravity with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the page talks about the backend agent pausing for input, but no Antigravity backend for it is shown or linked.
So this default agent never interrupts.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, the interrupt tool, wasn't on the page, so I added it myself.
And this agent that calls it, I added that too.
Moving on to the demo. It should pause and show the review panel, but the interrupt doesn't complete the way the page says.
So basically, the page needs a backend that pauses, and it never gives you one.
The default agent never pauses, so umm, even with my own agent it doesn't work the way the page says.
So kindly look into it, thanks.
